import json, random, sys, collections
sys.path.insert(0, '/app/work'); sys.path.insert(0, '/app/submission')
import gen as G, ref as R, main as M
dec = collections.Counter(); stat = collections.Counter()
gens = collections.Counter()
for it in range(300):
    rng = random.Random(777000 + it)
    doc = G.gen(rng)
    text = json.dumps(doc)
    root = json.loads(text, object_pairs_hook=M._hook_pairs, parse_float=M._reject_float, parse_constant=M._reject_constant)
    st = M.validate(root)
    out = M.replay(st)
    for p in out["packets"]: dec[p["decision"]] += 1
    for j in out["jobs"]: stat[j["status"]] += 1
    gens[(st.C, st.E, st.W, st.K, st.F, st.L, len(st.time_edges), len(st.count_edges))] += 1
print("decisions:", dict(dec))
print("statuses:", dict(stat))
print("distinct param shapes:", len(gens))
print("max packets in one run:", max(g.npkt if hasattr(g,'npkt') else 0 for g in [1]))
PYEOF
python3 coverage.py
